name: TextCtrlCode
meaning: single-byte control codes embedded in a formatted text buffer by the engine's printf 0x53495F and interpreted by every emitter (0x535F03, 0x535A88, 0x53618C, 0x5346FF, 0x533403, 0x533EC3, 0x533DDA)

name: TXT_COLOR
meaning: inline colour: the next THREE bytes are the 24-bit RGB (little-endian b,g,r as assembled by 0x535A88: b + g*0x100 + r*0x10000) written straight into Font.color. Contributes nothing to the measured width and is skipped by every scanner

name: TXT_SPACE
meaning: advance one Font.glyphWidth without emitting a quad; also the word-break character for the wrap scanner 0x5346FF
